title: Third reel begins; Rene Gelpi and guitar
summary: Third reel starts, and Netto says Rene Gelpi did not play guitar with them.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players

blocks.x: We got the third reel on now, Rene Netto.
I missed all that now. Did Rene Jalpe ever play guitar?
To my knowledge, no. I don't think Rene would play guitar. Not with us, anyway, if he went along there. But you said that they had two.
